scope: Actual bridge entry point with synthetic storage, admission, head and operation outcomes. Compiled and executed as static ARM64 Linux artifacts in a disposable 1 CPU / 2 GiB VM.
results: prepare request-ready exits 0; complete with matching completion exits 0
prepare pending-request, request-unknown, already-consumed and complete not-completed exit nonzero
the prior entry point returned zero for each of those four negative outcomes
limits: Exercises the standalone entry point exit status and output, not real filesystem, archive, model, peer, scheduling or end-to-end controller. Native controller calls bridge functions directly and has its own exit contract. Not a deployment qualification.
